description: This file defines the SupplyChainClient class in the Aws\SupplyChain namespace, which is used to interact with the AWS Supply Chain service. It primarily contains method annotations for various API operations related to supply chain management, such as creating, deleting, retrieving, and updating resources like jobs, data flows, datasets, and instances.

classes.name: SupplyChainClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Supply Chain service, providing methods for various supply chain related operations.

methods.name: createBillOfMaterialsImportJob
methods.description: Creates a new import job for the Bill of Materials.

methods.name: createDataIntegrationFlow
methods.description: Creates a new data integration flow.

methods.name: createDataLakeDataset
methods.description: Creates a new Data Lake dataset.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a new supply chain instance.

methods.name: deleteDataIntegrationFlow
methods.description: Deletes a specified data integration flow.

methods.name: deleteDataLakeDataset
methods.description: Deletes a specified Data Lake dataset.

methods.name: deleteInstance
methods.description: Deletes a specified supply chain instance.

methods.name: getBillOfMaterialsImportJob
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific Bill of Materials import job.

methods.name: getDataIntegrationFlow
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific data integration flow.

methods.name: getDataLakeDataset
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific Data Lake dataset.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific supply chain instance.

methods.name: listDataIntegrationFlows
methods.description: Lists all data integration flows.

methods.name: listDataLakeDatasets
methods.description: Lists all Data Lake datasets.

methods.name: listInstances
methods.description: Lists all supply chain instances.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags attached to a resource.

methods.name: sendDataIntegrationEvent
methods.description: Sends a data integration event.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Attaches tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateDataIntegrationFlow
methods.description: Updates an existing data integration flow.

methods.name: updateDataLakeDataset
methods.description: Updates a Data Lake dataset.

methods.name: updateInstance
methods.description: Updates a supply chain instance.
